newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam studying gas industry master plan.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam studying gas industry master plan.

text.p: Vietnam is preparing a gas master plan for the development of the gas industry up to 2010, an official with state-owned Vietnam Oil and Gas Corp (Petrovietnam) said on Wednesday.
The study would look into supply and demand as well as government policy on gas, said Vu Van Mao, Director of Petrovietnam's Information Centre.
He said the study would evaluate Vietnam's gas potential, production possibilities, transportation, processing and distribution.

It would also set up gas utilisation patterns, determine users' choice of energy and propose measures to balance supply and demand, Mao said at the preview of Vietnam's Third International Oil and Gas Exhibition.
He said the details of the master plan would be announced at the exhibition, to be held in Ho Chi Minh City from March 26 to 28.
Vietnam projects its oil and gas production will rise to 30 to 40 million tonnes by 2010.
